articles.title: As heat and dry conditions fan wildfires in France, volunteers fan out to help - AP News
articles.description: Jean-François Pauner is among many volunteers helping firefighters battle wildfires in southwestern France. The fires have devastated 42,000 hectares west of Bordeaux, forcing nearly a quarter-million people from their homes. This summer, Europe faces extreme…
